sloka: न च तप्येद् यथा च असौ वन वासम् गते मयि ।महा राजः तथा कार्यो मम प्रिय चिकीर्षया ॥२-४५-१०॥
transliteration: na ca tapyed yathā ca asau vana vāsam gate mayi ।mahā rājaḥ tathā kāryo mama priya cikīrṣayā ॥2-45-10॥

translations.english: If you desire to please me, act in such a way that the king does not grieve after I have gone to the forest.
